subject: MarketCart demo readiness: quick fit questions + calendar sync
body:
From: Ellie Watson <ellie@marketcart.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo? signed up + usage snapshot

Hi Avery,

I signed up for Redwood last week (trial) and would love a short demo to understand how Redwood would fit our inference needs. We're MarketCart — a mid-market e-commerce analytics platform. High-level info:~
- Use case: real-time product ranking + session personalization (embedding + completion).
- Current footprint: ~3M requests/month, peaks to ~600 RPS during flash sales, average sequence length ~120 tokens.
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in Q3 with production in Q4.

Can someone on your team run through model choices, expected cost per thousand tokens, and what the pilot ramp would look like? We're PST (San Francisco) based.

Thanks,
Ellie Watson
Head of Data Platform
MarketCart
ellie@marketcart.com

---

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Watson <ellie@marketcart.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? signed up + usage snapshot

Hi Ellie — great to meet you and glad you tried Redwood. I'm Avery (AE on this account). Before we lock a demo, two quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Is the 3M requests/month number counting every inference call (including embeddings + completions) or just generation calls? If mixed, can you split approx % for embeddings vs completions?
2) For the 600 RPS peak, is that sustained for a short burst (minutes) or more sustained (tens of minutes+)? Also what concurrency (number of simultaneous active sessions) does that translate to?
3) Any strict data residency or SOC2/PCI constraints we need to plan for during pilot?
4) Who else would you want on the call from MarketCart? Engineering, security, or product?

Tentative agenda I suggest: 20 min architecture + cost profile, 25 min runtime/demo with perf expectations, 10 min next steps & pilot scope. If that sounds right, pick a 30/45 minute slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min — or I can propose three windows below.

Cc'ing Kimberly (Solutions Engineer) to join the technical portion.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Watson <ellie@marketcart.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? signed up + usage snapshot

Hi Ellie — I'm Priyom on the SDR team. Thanks for signing up. A few practical slots that work for our team next week (all PST):

- Tue Jun 16 — 11:00–11:30am PT (30m)
- Wed Jun 17 — 2:00–2:45pm PT (45m)
- Thu Jun 18 — 10:00–10:45am PT (45m)

If none work, use our Calendly link and we'll auto-confirm: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

Also, attaching a quick sample CSV of the request profile we ask customers to paste into the intake form (traffic_sample.csv) — if you can share something like this ahead of the call we can run an initial cost/profile estimate and have benchmarks ready.

HubSpot deal: MC-8701 (internal).

Thanks —
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachment: traffic_sample.csv (attachment stub)

---

From: Ellie Watson <ellie@marketcart.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco@marketcart.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? signed up + usage snapshot

Thanks — Tue Jun 16 11:00am PT works for us. I've invited Marco (CTO) to the calendar invite; he's the technical owner.

I've attached a short architecture doc that shows how we currently flow requests (architecture-overview.pdf). For your prep: embeddings are ~65% of calls, completions ~35%; the 600 RPS is a 10–15 minute sustained burst during promotions, concurrency ~450 at peak.

A quick agenda ask from our side:
- Short mapping of Redwood model/quantization options to cost per 10k tokens
- Expected tail latency at 400–600 RPS on Dedicated vs Hosted
- Deployment options for PCI-sensitive endpoints (we can surface details in follow-up)

Looking forward to the call — calendar invite sent.

Best,
Ellie Watson
Head of Data Platform, MarketCart
ellie@marketcart.com

Attachment: architecture-overview.pdf (attachment stub)
